ExecutionPacket.purpose: Add or update one approved task card without catalog, graph, or verification drift.
ExecutionPacket.contract-excerpt: Planned module contract excerpt goes here.
ExecutionPacket.graph-entry-excerpt: Knowledge graph entry excerpt goes here.

dependency-contract-summaries.dependency-1: Authoring, synchronization, stop-condition, and Beads evidence rules.
dependency-contract-summaries.dependency-2: Canonical metadata labels, visible sections, and progressive-disclosure structure.

assumptions.assumption-1: The mentor supplied or approved unambiguous metadata and task intent.
assumptions.assumption-2: The stable task slug and all prerequisites can be resolved before editing.

stop-conditions.condition-1: Stop for ambiguous metadata, missing prerequisite or asset, unreviewed solution logic, unexpected GitHub rendering, slug migration, or new tooling.

notes.note-1: Workers should only read more context when the packet is insufficient.
Only list graph facts that really changed in the code.

module-checks.command-1: Verify exact task metadata labels and mandatory document anchors.
module-checks.command-2: Resolve prerequisite, asset, and catalog links against the repository filesystem.
module-checks.command-3: Prove that the task slug appears exactly once in the catalog and graph annotations.

required-evidence-anchors.marker-2: Условие / Критерии готовности / Теория / Подсказка N / Решение / Самопроверка

required-trace-assertions.assertion-1: A task change must not complete before catalog and graph synchronization is verified.

wave-follow-up.item-1: Compare canonical task metadata with the catalog row and graph annotation.

phase-follow-up.item-1: Run the full catalog projection, vocabulary, XML, and sampled GitHub-rendering review.

FailurePacket.scenario: Task metadata and the student catalog disagree after an update.

expected-evidence.marker-1: Canonical task metadata and one matching README.md catalog row.
expected-evidence.assertion-1: The task slug and all projected metadata must match exactly.

observed-evidence.artifact-1: The task card contains one metadata value.
observed-evidence.artifact-2: The catalog row contains a different value or is missing.

FailurePacket.suggested-next-action: Keep task metadata canonical, repair the derived catalog and graph facts, and rerun the full projection checks.

evidence-captured.item-1: Task, catalog, graph annotation, resolved links, and mentor-review status agree.
